title: Punjab Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns Amid Paper Leak Scandal
summary: Punjab Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned following a paper leak scandal. The incident occurred during the Punjab Board of Secondary Education (PBSE) examinations, which began on March 15. According to reports, some students were found with leaked papers, and an investigation was launched. The opposition alleged that the government was trying to suppress dissent. The minister claimed that he would soon reveal his strategy for addressing the issue.
